description: This Java class defines a custom keyboard view component for an Android soft keyboard application, supporting mini pop-up keyboards that appear on long-press of keys. It manages the display, interaction, and theming of mini keyboards, including handling touch events, drawing overlays, and managing popup window lifecycle.

classes.name: AnyKeyboardViewWithMiniKeyboard
classes.description: A custom keyboard view that supports displaying mini popup keyboards on long-press of keys, managing their lifecycle, appearance, and interaction.

methods.name: setOnPopupShownListener
methods.description: Sets a listener to be notified when the mini keyboard popup is shown or hidden.

methods.name: getMiniKeyboard
methods.description: Returns the current mini keyboard view instance.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events, forwarding them to the mini keyboard if it is showing.

methods.name: isShifted
methods.description: Returns whether the mini keyboard or main keyboard is shifted.

methods.name: setupMiniKeyboardContainer
methods.description: Prepares the mini keyboard with the specified popup key and add-on, configuring its layout and correction.

methods.name: createPopupKeyboardForKey
methods.description: Creates an instance of the popup keyboard for a specific key, inflating from resources or using character data.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws overlay effects, such as dimming, when the mini keyboard popup is active.

methods.name: ensureMiniKeyboardInitialized
methods.description: Initializes the mini keyboard view if it hasn't been created yet.

methods.name: setPopupKeyboardWithView
methods.description: Displays the mini keyboard popup at specified screen coordinates with a given view.

methods.name: generateMiniKeyboardMotionEvent
methods.description: Creates a MotionEvent for the mini keyboard, offset by the origin coordinates.

methods.name: onLongPress
methods.description: Handles long-press events on keys to trigger the mini keyboard popup.

methods.name: setThemeOverlay
methods.description: Applies a theme overlay to the keyboard and mini keyboard.

methods.name: setKeyboardTheme
methods.description: Sets the theme for the keyboard, recreating mini keyboard if needed.

methods.name: showMiniKeyboardForPopupKey
methods.description: Displays the mini keyboard for a specific key, calculating position and setting up the popup.

methods.name: setPopupStickinessValues
methods.description: Configures whether the mini keyboard should stay visible or slide in, injecting motion events if needed.

methods.name: dismissPopupKeyboard
methods.description: Dismisses the mini keyboard popup if it is showing.

methods.name: disableTouchesTillFingersAreUp
methods.description: Disables touch input until fingers are lifted, also dismissing the mini keyboard.

methods.name: resetInputView
methods.description: Resets the input view, dismissing the mini keyboard if necessary.

methods.name: onViewNotRequired
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the view is no longer required.
